# Truth Vault Production Manifest — Snopes Timeless Library

**Total candidates:** 6673  
**Batch size:** 15  
**Total batches:** 445  
**Current library:** 1,333 entries  
**Target:** ~8,000 entries (library + manifest)  

## Production Protocol

Each batch fires via cron, spawning subagents that:
1. Fetch the Snopes source article
2. Apply EARC framework (Enhance/Augment/Replicate/Contrast)
3. Write entry with full epistemological audit
4. Article length matches content demand — simple debunks: ~2,500w;
   epistemologically rich claims: 3,000–5,000w; deep contested-consensus: up to 6,000w
5. Verify count, commit, push, report

## Length Guidelines

| Content type | Target length | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| Simple photo/video verification | 2,000–2,500w | "Is this image real?" claims |
| Standard myth/misconception | 2,500–3,500w | Folk wisdom, health myths, urban legends |
| Epistemologically rich | 3,500–5,000w | Consciousness, intelligence, folk wisdom with real kernels |
| Deep contested-consensus | 4,000–6,000w | Vitamin C, acupuncture, replication crisis topics |
| Meta-analysis / cross-review | 5,000–8,000w | Multi-source systematic reviews |
